artwork.title: Prism Album Cover
artwork.description: The iconic album cover featuring a prism dispersing white light into a rainbow spectrum against a black background, representing the album's themes of light, darkness, and transformation.
artwork.copyrightNotice: © 1973 Pink Floyd Music Ltd. Design by Hipgnosis.

artwork.title: Back Cover
artwork.description: The back cover features the reverse image: a rainbow converging into a prism, symbolizing unity and completion.
artwork.copyrightNotice: © 1973 Pink Floyd Music Ltd. Design by Hipgnosis.

artwork.title: Abbey Road Studios Session
